Bangla.question: ১) “ওরে প্রাণের বাসনা প্রাণের আবেগ রুধিয়া রাখিতে নারি।” - উক্তিটি কার?
Bangla.exp: “ওরে প্রাণের বাসনা প্রাণের আবেগ রুধিয়া রাখিতে নারি।” পঙক্তিটি কবিগুরু রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর রচিত ‘নির্ঝরের স্বপ্নভঙ্গ’ কবিতা থেকে নেয়া হয়েছে

Bangla.question: ২) ‘রত্ন > রতন’ কোন ধরণের ধ্বনির পরিবর্তন?
Bangla.exp:
সময় সময় উচ্চারণের সুবিধার জন্য সংযুক্ত ব্যঞ্জন-ধ্বনির মাঝখানে স্বরধ্বনি আসে।
একে বলা হয় মধ্য স্বরাগম বা বিপ্রকর্ষ বা স্বরভক্তি।
যেমন - রত্ন > রতন ; ধর্ম > ধরম ; প্রীতি > পিরীতি ইত্যাদি।
[সূত্র: বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ-নবম দশম শ্রেণী]

Bangla.question: ৩) ঊনসত্তরের গণঅভ্যুত্থানের পটভূমিতে লেখা উপন্যাস-
Bangla.exp:
আহমদ ছফা রচিত উপন্যাস-
সূর্য তুমি সাথী,
ওঙ্কার,
মরণবিলাস,
গাভী বিত্তান্ত,
অর্ধেক নারী অর্ধেক ঈশ্বরী,
বিহঙ্গ পুরাণ,
একজন আলী কেনানের উত্থান-পতন।
ওঙ্কার উপন্যাসটি মূলত ঊনসত্তরের গণঅভ্যুত্থানের পটভূমিতে লেখা হয়েছে। আহমদ ছফা রচিত এই উপন্যাসের নায়ক, আবু নসরের বোবা মেয়েকে বিয়ে করে। আবু নসরের সঙ্গে আইয়ুব খানের সম্পর্ক থাকায় সে এক ধরনের ক্ষমতা লাভ করে। আর এই ঘটনার সূত্র ধরে উপন্যাসটির কাহিনী গতি লাভ করেছে।
উৎসঃ বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য জিজ্ঞাসা, ড. সৌমিত্র শেখর।

Bangla.question: ৪) ‘হরি ঘোষের গোয়াল’ - বাগধারাটির অর্থ কি?
Bangla.exp:
হরি ঘোষের গোয়াল - বহু অপদার্থ ব্যক্তির সমাবেশ
হ য ব র ল - বিশৃঙ্খল
হাড় হাভাতে - হতভাগ্য
হুকো-নাপিত বন্ধ করা - সমাজচ্যুত করা
উৎসঃ বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য জিজ্ঞাসা-ড. সৌমিত্র শেখর

Bangla.question: ৫) বঙ্কিমচন্দ্র চট্টোপাধ্যায়ের উপন্যাস দুর্গেশনন্দিনী'র চরিত্র কোনটি?
Bangla.exp:
বঙ্কিমচন্দ্র চট্টোপাধ্যায় (১৮৩৮-১৮৯৪) আধুনিক বাংলা উপন্যাসের জনক বলে স্বীকৃত। ১৮৬৫ সালে প্রকাশিত ''দুর্গেশনন্দিনী'' বাংলা সাহিত্যের প্রথম স্বার্থক উপন্যাস যা বঙ্কিমচন্দ্রের প্রথম উপন্যাসও।
এই উপন্যাসের উল্লেখযোগ্য চরিত্র - বীরেন্দ্র সিংহ, ওসমান, জগৎসিংহ, তিলোত্তমা, আয়েশা, বিমলা প্রমুখ।
এই উপন্যাসের কেন্দ্রীয় নারী চরিত্র - তিলোত্তমা।
উৎসঃ বাংলাপিডিয়া, মোহসীনা নাজিলা রচিত শীকর বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য।

Bangla.question: ৬) “ধার্য” শব্দটির সঠিক প্রকৃতি-প্রত্যয় কোনটি?
Bangla.exp:
ঘ্যণ প্রত্যয় যুক্ত হয়ে গঠিত কৃৎ-প্রত্যয়ঃ
√ধৃ + ঘ্যণ = ধার্য;
√কৃ + ঘ্যণ = কার্য।
উৎসঃ মোহসীনা নাজিলা রচিত শীকর বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য।

Bangla.question: ৭) সুকান্ত ভট্টাচার্যের 'আঠারো বছর বয়স' কবিতাটি কোন কাব্যগ্রন্থের অন্তর্গত?
Bangla.exp:
'আঠারো বছর বয়স' কবিতাটি সুকান্ত ভট্টাচার্যের ছাড়পত্র কাব্যগ্রন্থের অন্তর্গত।
তাঁর রচিত অন্যান্য কাব্যগ্রন্থ- ঘুম নেই, পূর্বাভাস, মিঠেকড়া, অভিযান, গীতিগুচ্ছ (সঙ্গীত) ইত্যাদি।
উৎসঃ শীকর বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য, মোহসীনা নাজিলা ও লাইভ এমসিকিউ লেকচার।

Bangla.question: ৮) নিচের কোনটি ভিন্ন?
Bangla.exp:
প্রথম তিনটি যুগল পরস্পর সমার্থক।

সমুদ্র শব্দের প্রতিশব্দ - অর্ণব, জলধি, জলনিধি, পারাবার, বারিধি, রত্নাকর, সাগর, সিন্ধু।
অন্যদিকে জলদ শব্দের অর্থ মেঘ।
[সূত্র: বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ-নবম দশম শ্রেণী]

Bangla.question: ৯) ‘শিয়রে বাংলাদেশ' কাব্যগ্রন্থের রচয়িতা কে?
Bangla.exp:
বাংলাদেশের কবিদের কবি বলা হয় নির্মলেন্দু গুণকে।
প্রেমাংশুর রক্ত চাই,
না প্রেমিক না বিপ্লবী,
কবিতা অমীমাংসিত রমণী,
বাংলার মাটি বাংলার জল,
চাষাভুষার কাব্য,
দূর হ দুঃশাসন,
শিয়রে বাংলাদেশ,
মুঠোফোনের কাব্য,
নিশিকাব্য ইত্যাদি তাঁর রচিত কাব্যগ্রন্থ।
উৎসঃ শীকর বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য, মোহসীনা নাজিলা।

Bangla.question: ১০) শুদ্ধ বানানগুচ্ছ-
Bangla.exp:
শুদ্ধ বানানগুচ্ছ-
ক) কূপমণ্ডূক, দুর্নিরীক্ষ্য, দুষ্কর
খ) অর্চনা, বরেণ্য, পৈশাচী
গ) মােহিনী, লােভনীয়, সৌকর্য।
উৎস: শীকর বাংলা প্রশ্ন-পাঠ, মোহসীনা নাজিলা।

Bangla.question: ১১) “কাব্য জগতে যার নাম আনন্দ, তারই নাম বেদনা” - উক্তিটি কে করেছেন?
Bangla.exp:
“কাব্য জগতে যার নাম আনন্দ, তারই নাম বেদনা” - উক্তিটি করেছেন প্রমথ চৌধুরী।
তার আরো কয়েকটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ উক্তি হলো -
“সুশিক্ষিত লোক মাত্রই স্বশিক্ষিত”
“সাহিত্য জাতির দর্পণ স্বরূপ”
“হীরক ও কাঁচ যমজ হলেও সহোদর নয়” ইত্যাদি।
[সূত্রঃ লাইভ এমসিকিউ লেকচার]

Bangla.question: ১২) অনট্‌-প্রত্যয় যোগে গঠিত শব্দ নয় কোনটি?
Bangla.exp:
নয়ন= √নী + অনট্‌,
শ্রবণ= √শ্রু + অনট্‌ ও
নর্তন= √নৃত্‌ + অনট্‌।
দোলন= দোল + অন (ক্রিয়াবাচক বিশেষ্য গঠনে ‘অন’ প্রত্যয়ের ব্যবহার)।
সূত্রঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ (নবম-দশম শ্রেণি)

English.question: 1) The poem is written in a very lucid style. Synonym of Lucid?
English.exp:
Elaborate : involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design and planning.
Clear : easy to perceive, understand, or interpret.
Noble : belonging by rank, title, or birth to the aristocracy.
Intricate : very complicated or detailed.
Lucid : expressed clearly; easy to understand.
So, Synonym of lucid is clear

English.question: 2) Antonym of TERRIBLE-
English.exp:
Terrible : extremely bad or serious.
Horrible : causing or likely to cause horror; shocking.
Awesome : extremely impressive or daunting; inspiring awe.
Delightful : causing delight; charming.
Hideous : extremely ugly.
Antonym of Terrible is Delightful

English.question: 3) Careful is to cautious as boastful is to
English.exp:
Careful and cautious are synonyms (they mean the same thing).
Boastful and arrogant are also synonyms.
The answer is not (choice b) because humble means the opposite of boastful.
The answer is not choice c or d because neither means the same as boastful.

English.question: 4) Synonym of FRUGALITY
English.exp:
Foolishness : lack of good sense or judgement; stupidity.
Extremity : the furthest point or limit of something.
Enthusiasm : intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
Economical : (of a person or lifestyle) careful not to waste money or resources.
Frugality : the quality of being economical with money or food; thriftiness.
So, Synonym of Frugality is Economical

English.question: 5) Poles : Magnet :: ? : Battery:
English.exp: As magnet has poles similarly battery has terminals.

English.question: 6) Antonym of Mendacious-
English.exp:
Meaning: A mendacious person is one who tells lies habitually and intentionally.
Example: If you catch someone intentionally manipulating you with a falsehood, that person is just plain mendacious.
Synonyms: Dishonest, Deceitful, Fallacious, Fraudulent
Antonyms: Frank, Honest, Truthful, Sincere

English.question: 7) He has paid the penalty _____ his crimes _____ five years in prison.
English.exp: penalty for/with - পুরস্কার বা শাস্তি প্রদান করা এবং five years এর আগে with বসানো যায়।

English.question: 8) Synonym of ALACRITY
English.exp:
Fear :an unpleasant emotion caused by the belief that someone or something is dangerous, likely to cause pain, or a threat.
Frankness :open, honest, and direct in speech or writing, especially when dealing with unpalatable matters.
Alarm :an anxious awareness of danger, warning, alert, caveat, caution, admonition.
Briskness :active, fast, and energetic.
Alacrity :brisk and cheerful readiness.
So, Synonym of Alacrity is Briskness.

English.question: 9) Who wrote the famous poetic line ‘To err is human, to forgive divine’?
English.exp:
To err is human, to forgive divine’ Alexander Pope এর An Essay on Criticism থেকে নেওয়া।
[Source: britannica]

English.question: 10) The time is running out, you must look sharp.
English.exp:
'Look sharp' means - 'be quick'.
So, 'make haste' is the correct answer as it means 'Hurry'.

English.question: 11) A disease that spreads over a large area-
English.exp:
Academic : relating to education and scholarship.
Incorrigible : not able to be changed or reformed.
Invincible : too powerful to be defeated or overcome.
Epidemic : a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time.

English.question: 12) To drink like a fish
English.option4: ঘ) To drink in the company of others
English.exp: To drink like a fish: Consume large amounts of alcoholic beverages.

English.question: 13) A disease of mind causing an uncontrollable desire to steal-
English.exp:
Schizophrenia: a long-term mental disorder of a type involving a breakdown in the relation between thought, emotion, and behaviour, leading to faulty perception, inappropriate actions and feelings, withdrawal from reality and personal relationships into fantasy and delusion, and a sense of mental fragmentation.
Claustrophobia: extreme or irrational fear of confined places.
Kleptomania: a recurrent urge to steal, typically without regard for need or profit.
Megalomania: obsession with the exercise of power.

English.question: 14) Find out that word, which spelling is wrong?
15) Fear of spiders is known as-

Phobia is derived from Phobos which is a Greek word for fear.
While social phobia is fear of social interaction.

Hydro means water so Hydrophobia is fear of water.

English.question: 16) We don’t want to make your journey ______ by making you sit next to someone with whom you are not comfortable.
English.exp: যার সাথে বসতে Comfort বা স্বাচ্ছন্দ্যবোধ করবে না তার সাথে বসে গেলে সফর Unpleasant হবে। Successful বা Favorite বা  Worthy হবে না।

Math.question: ১) 12 pumps working 6 hours a day can empty a completely filled reservoir in 15 days. How many such pumps working 9 hours a day will empty the same reservoir in 12 days?
Math.exp:
Apply formula of (M1 D1 H1) / W1= (M2 D2 H2) / W2
Let 'P' pumps are required to empty the reservoir.
(12 pumps × 6 hours × 15 days) / 1 reservoir = (P × 9 hours × 12 days) / 1 reservoir
P = 10 pumps

Math.question: ২) There are 600 boys in a hostel. Each plays either hockey or football or both. If 75% play hockey and 45% play football, how many play both?
৩) A and B can do a work in 8 days, B and C can do the same work in 12 days. A, B and C together can finish it in 6 days. A and C together will do it in = ?
Math.exp:
(A+B+C)'s 1 day's work = 1/6
(A+B)'s 1 day's work = 1/8
(B+C)'s 1 day's work = 1/12
∴ (A+C)'s 1 day's work
= (2× 1/6) − (1/8 + 1/12)
= (1/3 − 5/24)
= 3/24
= 1/8
So, A and C together will do the work in 8 days.

Math.question: ৪)(X% of Y) + (Y% of X) is equal to:
Math.exp:
According to question, 
XY/100 + YX/100
= 2XY/100
= 2% o fXY

Math.question: ৫) To complete a work, A takes 50% more time than B. If together they take 18 days to complete the work, how much time shall B take to do it?
Math.exp:
We have B = 3/2 × A
→ A = 2/3 × B
One day's work, A+B = 1/18
2/3×B+B = 1/18
5/3×B = 1/18
Oneday's work of B = 3/90
B alone can complete the work in = 90/3 = 30days

Math.question: ৬) A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item 35% above its cost price. The percentage of discount allowed to gain 8% is -
Math.exp:
Let C.P.=Tk. 100 Then,
M.P. = Tk. 135, S.P. =Tk.108
∴Discount % =(27/135 ×100)% =20%

Math.question: ৭) A man on tour travels first 160 km at 64 km/hr and the next 160 km at 80 km/hr. Find the average speed for first 320 km of tour.
Math.exp:
We know Time = Distance/speed
So total time taken = (160/64) + (160/80)
Time taken for 320 Km = 320 × (2/9) = 71.11km/hr

Math.question: ৮) A dishonest dealer marks up the price of his goods by 20% and gives a discount of 10% to the customer. He also uses a 900 gram weight instead of a 1 kilogram weight. Find his percentage profit due to these maneuvers -
Math.exp:
Let CP = Tk 1 per gram
Then SP of 1000gram is 1000 + 20% of 1000 = Tk 1200
Now Dealer gives 10% discount
= 1200 - 10% of 1200
= Tk. 1080
Then, Dealer is dishonest and sells 900 g is 1080 And,
CP of 900 grams is 900 Profit
= 1080 - 900 = 180
∴ % profit = (180×100) / 900 = 20%

Math.question: ৯) A man is walking at a speed of 10 kmph. After every km, he takes rest for 5 minutes. How much time will he take to cover a distance of 5 km?
Math.exp:
Time taken by man if he did not stop = 5 km/10 kmph = 1/2 hr = 30 min
∵Man takes rest for 5 minutes on each km Total rest time= 5×4= 20 min
Total travelling time: = 30 min+20 min = 50 min

Math.question: ১০) A simple interest earned on certain amount is triple the money when invested for 16 year. What is the interest rate offered?
Math.exp:
Given,
S.I = 3
Principal Amount
=> 3A = A x 16 x R/100
By solving, we get
=> R = 18.75%

Math.question: ১১) With an uniform speed, a car covers a distance in 8 hours. Had the speed been increased by 4 km/hr, the same distance could have been covered in 7 hr and 30 min. What is the distance covered?
Math.exp:
Let the speed of car be x km/hr
Distance= Speed × Time
Distance = 8x km
According to the question,
⇒ (x+4)×7.5= 8x
⇒ 7.5x+30= 8x
⇒ 8x−7.5x= 30
⇒ 0.5x= 30
⇒x= (30/0.5)= 60 km/hr
Required distance: = 8 × 60 = 480 km

Math.question: ১২) The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 year. Five year ago, father's age was four times the age of the son. So, now the son's age will be:
Math.exp:
Let the present ages of son and father be x and (60 -x) year respectively.
Then, (60 - x) - 5= 4(x - 5)
55 - x = 4x - 20
5x = 75
=> x = 15

Math.question: ১৩) A train 125 m long passes a man, running at 5 km/hr in the same direction in which the train is going, in 10 seconds. The speed of the train is:
Math.exp:
Speed of the train relative to man
= 125/10 m/sec
= 25/2 m/sec
= (25/2)×(18/5) km/hr
= 45km/hr
Let the speed of the train be x km/hr.
Then, relative speed=(x−5)km/hr
∴x−5= 45 ⇒x = 50km/hr

Math.question: ১৪) Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4. If their LCM is 240, the smaller of two number is
Math.exp:
Let, these two numbers be 3x and 4x then their LCM = 12x
Now, according to question,
12x = 240
Or, x = 20
Thus, the numbers are (3x = 3 × 20)60 and (4x = 4 × 20) 80
Then smaller in this two is 60

Math.question: ১৫) A train speeds past a pole in 20 seconds and speeds past a platform 100 meters in length in 30 seconds. What is the length of the train?
Math.exp:
Let the length of the train be x meters and its speed be y m/sec.
Then, xy = 20
⇒ y = x/20
∴ (x+100)/30 = x/20
⇒ 30x = 20x + 2000
⇒ 10x = 2000
⇒ x = 200 meters

Math.question: ১৬) Find the highest common factor of 36 and 84.
১৭) The speed of a boat in still water in 22 km/hr and the rate of current is 4 km/hr. The distance travelled downstream in 24 minutes is:
Math.exp:
Speed downstream = (22+4) = 26 kmph
Time = 24 minutes = 24/60 hour = 2/5 hour
Distance travelled = Time × speed = (2/5) ×26 = 10.4 km

Math.question: ১৮) An error 2% in excess is made while measuring the side of a square. The percentage of error in the calculated area of the square is:
Math.exp:
100 cm is read as 102 cm.
A1 = (100 x 100) cm2 and A2 (102 x 102) cm2.
(A2 - A1) = [(102)2 - (100)2]
= (102 + 100) x (102 - 100)
= 404 cm2.
Percentage error
=404/(100 x 100) x 100%
= 4.04%

Math.exp:

=2√2–2−√2

Math.question: ২১) In one hour, a boat goes 14 km/hr along the stream and 8 km/hr against the stream. The speed of the boat in still water (in km/hr) is:
Math.exp:
Let speed of the boat in still water = a and speed of the stream = b
Then a+b = 14 a-b = 8
Adding these two equations,
we get 2a = 22
=> a = 11
ie, speed of boat in still water = 11 km/hr

Math.question: ২২) A, B and C enter into a partnership with capitals in the ratio 5:6:8. At the end of the business term, they received the profit in the ratio 5:3:12. Find the ratio of time for which they contributed their capitals -
Math.exp:
Profit= Time×Capital
invested Time= Profit/ Capital invested
Required ratio of time =5/5:3/6:12/8 =1:1/2:3/2 =2:1:3

Math.question: ২৩) Find the number of shares that can be bought for tk. 8200 if the market value is tk. 20 each with brokerage being 2.5%.
Math.exp:
Cost of each share = (20 + 2.5% of 20) = tk.20.5
Therefore, number of shares = 8200/20.5 = 400

Math.question: ২৪) In a mixture 60 litres, the ratio of milk and water 2:1. If the this ratio is to be 1:2, then the quantity of water to be further added is-
Math.exp:
Quantity of Milk = 60 × (2/3) = 40 liters
Quantity of water = 60-40 = 20 liters
As per question we need to add water to get quantity 1:2
=> 40/(20+x) = 1/2
=> 20 + x = 80
=> x = 60 liters

General Knowledge.question: ১) The Hundred Years' War (from 1337 to 1453) was fought between-
General Knowledge.exp: The Hundred Years' War was a long struggle between England and France over succession to the French throne. It lasted from 1337 to 1453, so it might more accurately be called the ''116 Years' War.''

General Knowledge.question: ২) The last independent sultan of Bengal was-
General Knowledge.exp:
Ghiyasuddin Mahmud Shah assassinated Alauddin Firoz Shah in 1533 and ascended the throne of Gaur. Notable incidents during his five-year reign were clashes with Afghan leader Sher Shah Shur. Finally, in 1536, Sher Shah captured Gaur and started Afghan rule in Bengal. The independent sultanate era started by Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah in Sonargaon in 1338. With the death of Ghiyasuddin Mahmud Shah in 1536, the two hundred year independent sultanate era in Bengal came to an end.
[Source: History and World Civilization of Bangladesh, 9th-10th class]

General Knowledge.question: ৩) Bangladesh's position in the world in mango production -
General Knowledge.exp:
According to the Ministry of Agriculture, Saltamami 2019, Bangladesh is seventh in the world in mango production and eighth in guava. Mango production has increased to about 24 lakh metric tons.
[Source: Ministry of Agriculture]

General Knowledge.question: ৪) The family structure of which ethnic group in Bangladesh is matriarchal?
General Knowledge.exp:
Of the 50 tribes living in Bangladesh, the family structure of the Khasia and Garo or Mandi communities is matriarchal. The family structure of all other tribes is patriarchal.
[Source: Bangladesh and World Identity: 7th and 8th grade and Banglapedia]

General Knowledge.question: ৫) Who is the guardian of the constitution of Bangladesh?
General Knowledge.exp:
The 'Supreme Court' is the guardian of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. It has two divisions. Namely- Appellate Division and High Court Division.
Source: Politics and Good Governance, Class XI-XII, Prof. Md. Mozammel Haque.

General Knowledge.question: ৭) 'Bhatiali' is a song from which part of Bangladesh?
General Knowledge.exp:
Bhatiali music is a famous folk culture of the greater Mymensingh region. Bhavaya Gaan Rangpur Region and Gambhira Gaan Chapainawabganj Region. Chittagong is famous for its famous folk culture and Bhandari songs.
(Source: Banglapedia)

General Knowledge.question: ৮) The founder of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is:
General Knowledge.exp:
The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is an international human rights organization. Its purpose is to protect and co-operate with human rights during conflicts and other persecutions. It is an independent and non-partisan organization founded in 183. It is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. Its founder is Henry Durant. The signatories to the Geneva Conventions have mandated the Red Cross to work on human rights.
Source- icrc.org website.

General Knowledge.question: ৯) How many main organs do United Nations has?
General Knowledge.exp:
There are six main organs of the United Nations.
1. UN General Assembly (UNGA),
2. UN Security Council (UNSC),
3. Economic and Social Organization (ECOSOC),
4. International Court of Justice (ICJ),
5. Trusteeship Council and
7. Secretariat.
All of them were formed in 1945. UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations.
Source: UN.org

General Knowledge.question: ১০) Which treaty is known as the Ottawa Treaty?
General Knowledge.exp:
Another name for the Mine Ban Treaty is the Ottawa Treaty. The agreement was signed on December 3, 1997 in Ottawa, Canada. Which came into effect on July 1, 1999. The purpose of this agreement is to prohibit the use, production and stockpiling of all types of landmines and to destroy them. Important countries like China, United States, Russia, Pakistan, India, North Korea, South Korea, Iran, Israel etc. have not signed the agreement.
Source - Live MCQ Lecture.

General Knowledge.question: ১৬) Which state in the United States has the highest number of electoral votes?
General Knowledge.exp:

Computer & Science.question: ১) The memory which is ultraviolet light erasable and electrically programmable is -
Computer & Science.exp:
An EPROM or erasable programmable read-only memory, is a type of memory chip that retains its data when its power supply is switched off. Computer memory that can retrieve stored data after a power supply has been turned off and back on is called non-volatile. It is an array of floating-gate transistors individually programmed by an electronic device that supplies higher voltages than those normally used in digital circuits. Once programmed, an EPROM can be erased by exposing it to strong ultraviolet light source (such as from a mercury-vapor light).
Source: merriam-webster.com

Computer & Science.question: ২) The most popular language for interactive use is:
Computer & Science.exp:
BASIC এর পূর্ণরূপঃ Beginners' All-purpose Symbolic Instruction Code
BASIC এর ডেভেলপমেন্টের মূল দর্শনটাই ছিল যেন বিজ্ঞানী বা গণিতবিদদের ছাড়াও সাধারণ মানুষজনও কোডিং করতে পারেন। যার ফলশ্রুতিতে ১৯৮০ পর্যন্ত এটাই ছিল সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সহজে ব্যবহারযোগ্য প্রোগ্রামিং ভাষা। নিঃসন্দেহে এটা প্রথম Highly Popular Interactive Language.
প্রশ্নটা মুলত একটা ইন্ডিয়ান সাইট থেকে নেয়া। আপনারা জানেন যে ব্যাংকের পরীক্ষায় ইন্ডিয়ান সাইটগুলো থেকে প্রায়ই প্রশ্ন আসে। তাই, আমাদের প্রশ্নগুলোতেও বেশ কিছু প্রশ্ন সাইটগুলো থেকে দেয়া হয়। অপশন হিসেবে উত্তর BASIC ঠিক আছে। তবে, বর্তমানে সরাসরি BASIC এর ব্যবহার নেই বললেই চলে।

COBOL: used in business, finance, and administrative systems for companies and governments.
PASCAL: encourage good programming practices using structured programming and data structuring.
FORTRAN (FORmula Translation): it was designed to allow easy translation of mathematical formulas into code.

Computer & Science.question: ৩) Which of the following computer language is used for artificial intelligence?
Computer & Science.exp:
Prolog, Python, Lisp, Java, and C++ are major AI programming language used for artificial intelligence capable of satisfying different needs in development and designing of different software.
Prolog : Prolog is a declarative language where programs are expressed in terms of relations, and execution occurs by running queries over these relations. Prolog is particularly useful for symbolic reasoning, database and language parsing applications. Prolog is widely used in AI today.
Source: Fundamentals of Programming

Computer & Science.question: ৪) Which computer has been designed to be as compact as possible?
Computer & Science.exp: A microcomputer is a small, relatively inexpensive computer with a microprocessor as its central processing unit (CPU). It includes a microprocessor, memory, and input/output (I/O) facilities. Microcomputers became popular in the 1970s and 80s with the advent of increasingly powerful microprocessors.

Computer & Science.question: ৫) Which was the first web browser?
Computer & Science.exp:
WorldWideWeb was Introduced on 26th February 1991 by British scientist.

৭) Which one is not an input device?
Computer & Science.exp:
In computing, an input device is a piece of computer hardware equipment used to provide data and control signals to an information processing system such as a computer or information appliance. Examples of input devices include keyboards, mouse, scanners, digital cameras and joysticks.
Source: Computer Basic General Knowledge

Computer & Science.question: ৮) Which of the following is used as 'Input device' for the computer?
Computer & Science.exp: A light pen, also called a selector pen, is a computer input device in the form of a light-sensitive wand used in conjunction with a computer's CRT display. It allows the user to point to displayed objects or draw on the screen in a similar way to a touchscreen but with greater positional accuracy.

Computer & Science.question: ৯) Optical fibers are mainly used for which of the following?
Computer & Science.exp: Optical fibers are mainly used in telecommunications, but they are also used for lighting, sensors, toys, and special cameras for seeing inside small spaces. They are sometimes used in medicine to see inside people, like down their throat.

Computer & Science.question: ১০) HTML is used to-
Computer & Science.option3: গ) Translate one language into another
Computer & Science.exp: Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.

Computer & Science.question: ১১) Which mode loads minimal set of drivers when starting Windows?
Computer & Science.exp: Safe mode is a diagnostic mode of a computer operating system (OS). It can also refer to a mode of operation by application software. In Windows, safe mode only allows essential system programs and services to start up at boot. Safe mode is intended to help fix most, if not all problems within an operating system. It is also widely used for removing rogue security software.

Computer & Science.question: ১২) Ctrl + J is used to-
Computer & Science.exp: Ctrl+J aligns the selected text or line to justify the screen.
